assertions.source: Strategy I: canonical Wedderburn `+3/4·h²` + Yekutieli per-cell `−G·h²` ≈ 2.49266 (vs canonical 2.55304); Vol·λ_Yek/ℏ_q²·m_e ≈ 951 MeV; 1.4% vs CODATA m_avg vs canonical 2.9%.

description: Borromean baryon mass prediction under the Yekutieli-extended λ_scale = 5/2 + (3/4 − G)·h².  Categorically-conditional (load-bearing cell-↔-half-sym-projection bijection at H_4).  Composed with PR #942's substrate flavor split, predicts m_p ≈ 950 MeV, m_n ≈ 952 MeV — ~1.3 % vs CODATA, gap halved from the canonical-only (Family A) ~2.9 %.  Probe / comparison column only — NOT a production replacement; the production prediction in `m_p_borromean_verification_50dps.py` uses the PROVED canonical λ_A only.
caveats: Yekutieli per-cell curvature term `−G·h²` is categorically-conditional on the load-bearing cell-↔-half-sym-projection bijection at H_4 (see `docs/audits/2026-05-22-yekutieli-percell-conjecture-formalized.md` §Conjecture).  The bijection sketch in the audit (vertex / edge / center octahedra ↔ conjugate-pair / self-conjugate partitions at H_4) is structurally natural but lacks an explicit construction + sign-convention verification.  Production `m_p_borromean_verification_50dps.py` uses ONLY the PROVED canonical λ_A; this script's Yekutieli-extended predictions are research-grade comparison data, not production claims.
